own_solution.law: R = rho L / A with constant volume (A L const) gives R' = n^2 R = 9 x 2 = 18 ohm; P = E^2 / R'
assumptions: uniform drawing, constant resistivity and temperature

notes: With the 7.5 V cell in series aiding: emf 19.5 V, P = 380.25/18 = 21.125 W. T4B85 'Before the power was measured ... was connected' I read as the cell remaining in circuit during the measurement (R); a reader could wonder whether it was removed, but the natural reading is that it is in place. Original length (45 cm) enters R = rho L/A but cancels because only the ratio 3 and the original resistance matter (C). TE42B and T4F86 say 'a small cell' with no value, unlike the 7.5 V variants; if they are meant as minimal-pair variants of the 7.5 V sentences, they differ in the stated number. Their roles (D) do not depend on the value.
